verdict.rationale: The official Airwallex CLI is documented as letting you "script repeatable tasks, and wire Airwallex into automated systems" against sandbox (the default) or production. Scoped API keys give least-privilege, non-interactive access to the API, and the separate sandbox suits automated test runs. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g., pipeline examples or env-var config), a documented non-interactive CLI auth path (the CLI's documented auth is OAuth, role-gated to Owner/Admin/Finance Admin), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
